title: When the Workflow Becomes the Object | A Cinematic Research Brief
base_title: When the Workflow Becomes the Object
description:
Optimization gets weirder once the workflow itself becomes the thing you are tuning, measuring, and rewriting.

This cinematic brief turns the bonus chapter into a broader systems claim: the real object of optimization is often the scaffold, evaluation loop, and workflow composition around the model.

It should catch viewers who care less about single prompts and more about operational leverage.
